kind: ephemeral local Candid reply evidence; no persisted product record

status_projection.controller_owner: model::control_authority::ControllerSet; canonical sorted unique principal identities
status_projection.other_fields: skipped under finite work; no retained values or shape/presence/semantic validation
status_projection.scope: a projection, not full upstream CanisterStatusResult validation
status_projection.tuple: no additional arguments or trailing bytes

acknowledgement.admission: no type table, arguments or trailing bytes; Candid null is not an empty tuple

hashing.digest: SHA-256 of domain, terminator and body
hashing.association: declared by caller; no wire network/caller/target/challenge identity

diagnostics: no raw payload, controller IDs or upstream decoder prose
